Services

Precision drafting, grounded in how plants actually run.

01Industrial LayoutsExpansions, re-layouts and greenfield plans in 2D AutoCAD.
02Machinery PlacementEquipment drawings aligned with infrastructure, clearances, maintenance access and safety.
03Sketch-to-CAD & As-BuiltSketches, redline PDFs and legacy paper drawings converted to standardized DWG.
04Workflow & LogisticsMaterial flow and shop-floor workflow, drawn with Lean principles.
05Technical DocumentationDrawings for SOPs, safety routing and process maps.

Case studies

Experience from the plants where this work began.

Drawn from my industrial career. Client work since founding the studio is shared on request, under NDA where needed.

Machinery placement · USA

High-tonnage press line, General Motors plant

Context. Field installation, mechanical assembly and try-out of an automotive press line, on assignment for ANDRITZ Schuler.

What it taught me. Positioning, clearances and crane access decide whether a drawing can actually be built. I bring that to every layout.

Discuss a similar project
Industrial layouts · Brazil

Manufacturing cells and shop-floor layouts

Context. At VOSS Automotive I developed new manufacturing cells and layouts, working in AutoCAD, CATIA and SAP/TOTVS.

What it taught me. A good layout starts with material flow and operator ergonomics, then becomes a clean drawing.

Discuss a similar project
Technical documentation · Brazil & USA

SOPs that connect engineering to the floor

Context. At ANDRITZ Schuler I wrote standard procedures and worked with suppliers so designs reached the shop floor without ambiguity.

What it taught me. Documentation and drawings must say the same thing, or the floor pays for it.
